versions.changelog: The API key is now optional to load this skill; with no key, a pointer leads to a temporary free key with no signup and a link the user opens to keep it.
notableChanges is described for both tiers: PRO returns it with limit, the free preview omits it. Upgrade link uses coupon AGENTS.
Declares permissions: network, credential, shell, and files.
Corrects the per-holding value field name to valueUsd, aligns the quarter parameter with the endpoint list, and describes the shape of the flows response.

holders/{ticker} no longer requires reportDate: omit it and the endpoint resolves the latest settled quarter with holders for that ticker and echoes the quarter it used. The quarter-first rule now excepts holders. CLI pin 0.52.0.

Resolve the 13F quarter by the pending flag, never by position. Once the 45-day filing window closes there is no pending entry at all, so code that skips the first row quotes a quarter a full three months staler than what it was served.
Document FREE preview exception: returnedCount/offset/notableChanges omitted on free tier even with limit
Convergence guidance now includes insider Form 4 activity.
Bonds and options endpoints listed, agent identity guidance
Initial release: 13F institutional ownership by ticker or manager, quarter-over-quarter ownership-change deltas, and top-10 holders per stock.
